name: BRAND TEXT
description:
Indoor home Infrared Sauna units by Heilsa bring the ultimate experience of Infrared light therapy to help every customer relax, rejuvenate and improve health with no excess expense. What makes Infrared Saunas better than any other traditional sauna is the comfortable temperatures and the soothing heat that penetrates the skin much deeper, relieving many health problems and helping your body to detoxify faster and with less harm. .



A frequent 30 minutes spent in the comfort of a personal Infrared Sauna Unit can help with many health problems – from sport injuries to detoxification, and this will cost you no more that using a hair dryer. And even more – Infrared Therapy is so safe that you can enjoy your Infrared Sauna every day!



Heilsa Saunas are easy to use and assemble; there are no special wiring, ventilation or plumbing needed; they are inexpensive to operate indoors: high quality Canadian Hemlock and tempered glass is used in construction of every sauna unit to ensure that each unit will withstand time.
